description: This file defines an enum class 'DarkModeSetting' that encapsulates different dark mode options for an Android application, including methods to retrieve mode IDs and convert from mode IDs to enum instances.

classes.name: DarkModeSetting
classes.description: An enum representing the dark mode options with associated mode IDs and utility methods for conversion.

methods.name: getModeId
methods.description: Returns the integer mode ID associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: fromModeID
methods.description: Converts an integer mode ID to the corresponding DarkModeSetting enum constant, throwing NoSuchElementException if no match is found.
